item.title: Zach Charbonnet: Won't debut Week 5
item.description:
Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Tank Dell: Expected to practice Week 5
item.description:
Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he expects the Texans to open Dell's (knee) 21-day practice window this week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

item.title: Caleb Williams: Not ready to play Week 5
item.description:
Head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Williams (hamstring) will remain out for the Bears' Week 5 game against the Packers, Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

item.title: Tyson Bagent: Remaining starter for Week 5
item.description:
Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that Bagent will start Sunday's game against the Packers in Green Bay, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

item.title: Pat Bryant: Set to miss time with ankle sprain
item.description:
Bryant is expected to miss "a few weeks" after spraining his right ankle in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the 49ers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
